nodes.label: Tavla App Icon (favicon)
nodes.rationale: Next.js app/icon.svg file convention: auto-served as site favicon/app icon. 1024x1024 rounded square (rx 230) in near-black #111214 with a white glyph, minimalist monochrome brand mark.

nodes.label: Tavla 'T' Monogram with Dot
nodes.rationale: White glyph: wide rounded horizontal bar, rounded vertical stem descending from its center, and a circle dot at upper right - a stylized lowercase-t / 'T' for Tavla with an i-like accent dot.

nodes.label: Tavla App Icon (1024px)
nodes.description: Rounded-square near-black (#131416-ish) tile with a white monoline lowercase/rounded 'T' and a white dot at upper right, forming a stylized 't'/'i' with accent.
nodes.rationale: High-resolution square brand mark for app icons, PWA manifest, apple-touch-icon and favicon generation; minimal monochrome design scales down cleanly.

nodes.label: T + Dot Monogram
nodes.rationale: Letter T for Tavla with rounded stroke terminals; the offset dot adds a playful accent (possibly evoking a game piece/checker, as 'tavla' is backgammon).

nodes.label: Tavla 'T' Monogram with Dot
nodes.rationale: Minimal geometric mark: thick rounded-stroke T (initial of Tavla) with a circular dot, monochrome white-on-dark for high contrast at small sizes.

nodes.label: Tavla App Icon (512px)
nodes.rationale: Square 512x512 brand icon: white rounded lowercase-style 't' with a dot above its right arm (reads like a 't' + 'i'/accent dot) on a near-black (#111214-ish) background. Sized for PWA manifest / apple-touch / favicon usage.

nodes.label: Tavla App Icon
nodes.rationale: Square 1024x1024 icon with rounded corners (rx 230), sized like an app or favicon tile; minimal monochrome mark for small-size legibility

nodes.label: Stylized T Glyph with Dot
nodes.rationale: White pill-shaped crossbar and rounded stem form a 'T' (for Tavla), with a circular dot at the top right as an accent

nodes.label: Tavla Brand Mark (logo icon)
nodes.rationale: Minimal monochrome (#1F1F21) geometric glyph: a full-width rounded horizontal bar, a vertical stem with rounded bottom dropping from its center, and a circular dot at top-right. Reads as a stylized lowercase 't' (Tavla initial) with an accent dot; compact square-ish viewBox (582x578) suits favicon/app icon/header logo usage.

nodes.label: Contact Form (api/contact)
nodes.rationale: In dev works without Resend key (logs to terminal); in production without Resend vars returns clear 'sending unavailable' message.

nodes.label: content/ Directory
nodes.rationale: All text and data live in content/ so it can change without touching components; adding a photo auto-switches section from illustration to photo.

nodes.label: Environment Variables
nodes.rationale: No secret key has NEXT_PUBLIC_ prefix so secrets never reach the browser.

nodes.label: Tavla Marketing Website
nodes.rationale: Separate project from the Tavla app; does not touch the app repo or its database. Site uses no database - demo runs only in the visitor's browser.

nodes.label: Next.js Agent Rules
nodes.rationale: This Next.js version has breaking changes; agents must read bundled docs before writing code and heed deprecations. Block is re-added by next dev, so committing it keeps the tree clean.

nodes.label: English Version Plan (hreflang)
nodes.rationale: Add content/en, routes under app/en/, and alternates.languages in app/layout.tsx for hreflang.

nodes.label: Form Security Measures
nodes.rationale: Origin header check (CSRF), server-side zod validation, size limit, honeypot, time trap, rate limit, optional Turnstile, HTML escaping in email.

nodes.label: Rate Limit (5 per 10 min per hashed IP)
nodes.norm_label: rate limit (5 per 10 min per hashed ip)

nodes.label: Security Headers (next.config.ts)
nodes.rationale: CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options, nosniff, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy.
